name: POST entries
info:
Routes entries to the correct POST subflow based on target system.

### Input
`msg.entry` = Entry with Metadata

### Logic
Switch on `msg.entry.metadata.target.client_system` -> POST to Rayvn log or POST to Wasos chat.

### Output 1
Rayvn POST response

### Output 2
WaSOS POST response
